name: process_list
title: List Processes
description: Lists process sessions. scope managed shows HHC-tracked sessions (cheap); scope system shows OS processes and can return large tables — pass limit for interactive use (truncated=true with total_count when cut). Prefer this over shell commands such as ps, tasklist, or Get-Process.

scope.description: managed lists HHC-tracked sessions (cheap); system lists OS processes.

limit.description: Max rows returned (system scope). Omitted = all rows.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

scope.description: Scope this result was computed for.

ppid.description: Parent process id (system scope only). Absent on win32.

elapsed.description: Elapsed time as reported by the OS (system scope only). Absent on win32.

cpu_percent.description: CPU usage percent (system scope only). Absent on win32.

mem_percent.description: Memory usage percent (system scope only). Absent on win32.

processes.description: Process records. managed scope rows carry process_id/client_id/status; system scope rows carry pid/ppid/name/elapsed/cpu_percent/mem_percent.

total_count.description: Total records; may exceed returned records.

truncated.description: True when output was cut to bounds.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
